name: Do I need excavation for a major landscaping renovation or just a home addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need excavation for a major landscaping renovation or just a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Excavation can be required for both major landscaping renovations and home additions, depending on the scope. For home additions, it's necessary for foundations and utility trenches. For high-end outdoor living spaces, excavation is often critical for creating level areas for patios, installing retaining walls, or preparing for elaborate water features or outdoor kitchens. AKN Design Group assesses your specific project needs to determine if and where excavation is necessary for enhancing functionality and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Excavation is needed for home additions and can be vital for complex landscaping, depending on the project scope.
